propositions: _reads._tracker returns [] for a present directory lacking .git, .store-compat.json, and event dirs, instead of raising store_uninitialized, making broken stores indistinguishable from empty ones
A materialized .git-less snapshot with committed .store-compat.json and event data must remain readable by gate agents, establishing a load-bearing second predicate clause
Read and write sides must share one store-usability predicate to prevent divergence: reads gate on (directory AND (.git+resolvable HEAD OR structure)), writes additionally require .git to commit
The HEAD-resolution probe must be timeout-bounded via gitutil.run_git_bounded to preserve the write-path invariant that lock-held git calls are wall-clock bounded
An OSError from a missing git binary must propagate as a distinct environment fault rather than collapsing into store_uninitialized
The audit-server consumer must log a warning and render an empty page for any present-but-unusable store rather than silently blanking it
